issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): _combine_mutation_outcomes is private across split project-mutation modules
issue.description: During unrelated tests/test_launch_admission.py split verification, just check failed at lint (symvision) with: Private functions/classes should not be imported: _combine_mutation_outcomes in src/sase/bead/_project_mutations_shared.py. The non-test imports are src/sase/bead/_project_mutations_crud.py and src/sase/bead/_project_mutations_evidence.py. git log shows these files were introduced by 37c8e303a, refactor(bead): split _project_mutations.py into per-concern submixins. This is not an exact duplicate of closed private-import cleanup tasks sase-f4 or sase-mk; those covered older symbols in other modules and were closed after symvision was clean. Scope: make the shared helper public if it is now cross-file API, or stop importing it across module boundaries. Verify with just _lint-symvision and just check.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: This is a deterministic static lint failure, not a timing-dependent test. just check failed at lint (symvision) on HEAD ec889f587 after fmt, Ruff, mypy, feature-flag, script, wait, changelog, and terminology gates passed. The source files are unchanged in this workspace; the reported symbol is imported by non-test modules every run until the code is changed.
